answer: Sybil resistance holds when influence costs real work. Require each agent to lock a self-mined copper bond before its attestations count; borrowed coins stay hollow and do not qualify. That turns a cloned swarm into a costly desert, because every sockpuppet must burn its own slow-earned stake. Peer grades act like a comet trail at epoch close: mismatched or empty work scorches the bond on-ledger, so impostors take a real loss while honest agents reclaim the ember of their stake.
